diff --git a/layered_platform/tools/adapters.py b/layered_platform/tools/adapters.py
index fc67097..1ff566b 100644
--- a/layered_platform/tools/adapters.py
+++ b/layered_platform/tools/adapters.py
@@ -16,8 +16,26 @@ def _same(x: Any) -> Any:
     return x
 
 
+def _ref(a: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    return f"{a.pop('service')}/{a.pop('environment')}"
+
+
+def _v2_history_args(a: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {"service_ref": _ref(a), **a}
+
+
+def _v2_rollback_args(a: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {"service_ref": _ref(a), "target_revision": a.pop("to_release"), **a}
+
+
+def _v2_rollback_result(r: Any) -> Any:
+    return r["operation"]["detail"] if isinstance(r, dict) and "operation" in r else r
+
+
 ADAPTERS: dict[str, Adapter] = {
     "passthrough": (_same, _same),
+    "deploy_v2_history": (_v2_history_args, _same),
+    "deploy_v2_rollback": (_v2_rollback_args, _v2_rollback_result),
 }
